items.lead: Reach MSPs that could use your security, backup, monitoring or billing tools.
items.detail: An MSP list puts your product in front of the providers who buy and bundle tools on behalf of their clients, rather than the end customers one at a time.

visualData.label: Vendor tools such as security, backup, monitoring and billing reach MSPs, who bundle tools for their clients. Illustrative relationships, not customer counts.

items.lead: Find providers who might resell, refer or build on your product.
items.detail: Check the available job titles in your sample before planning a partner campaign.

visualData.label: Resell, refer and build form a cycle of possible partner routes. These are opportunities to assess, not confirmed partnerships.

items.lead: Invite MSPs to a webinar, a demo or a regional event, not the whole IT industry.
items.detail: Choose the closest segment in the form and describe your target region in Custom requirements. Check the sample before planning outreach.
